entries.reachability_signal: The reproducer writes to /sys/class/net/<bond>/bonding/xmit_hash_policy which triggers bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set. With an XDP program loaded on an 802.3ad/balance-xor bond, the guard returns -EOPNOTSUPP. Without XDP, all policies are accepted. Coverage can be confirmed via gcov on bond_options.c if the kernel is built with GCOV_KERNEL=y.
entries.expected_signal: echo 'vlan+srcmac 2' > /sys/class/net/<bond>/bonding/xmit_hash_policy returns EOPNOTSUPP when XDP is loaded; returns success when XDP is not loaded.
entries.input_strategy: Test with and without an XDP program loaded on the bond device. Input axes: (1) XDP loaded + vlan+srcmac policy (should fail), (2) XDP loaded + other policy (should succeed), (3) XDP not loaded + vlan+srcmac (should succeed), (4) mode change from balance-xor to active-backup + XDP loaded (should succeed).
entries.limitations: Requires: (1) root/sudo privileges for bond device creation and XDP loading, (2) bonding kernel module loaded, (3) bpftool for XDP program loading or a compiled .o XDP program, (4) VM or host with kernel that can load XDP programs. Kernel module build requires kernel headers and GCOV_KERNEL=y for coverage instrumentation.
